shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ---; find /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents -type f | head -100; echo ---; ls -la /home/sandbox/workspace; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat package.json; echo ---; find src -type f; echo ---; for f in src/*  src/*/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done; echo ---; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150; echo; echo ---; grep -n -i -A6 "i18n\|localiz\|locale" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat tsconfig.json | tail -15

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; for p in i18n icons uikit; do echo "== $p"; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; done; grep -n "i18n\|icons" package-lock.json | head -20; echo ---; grep -rn '"@gravity-ui/i18n"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -150; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build; echo ---; grep -rn "export declare function configure\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "function configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build --include=*.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -rln "configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -rn "export.*configure\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.txt 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "configure\|lang" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -200

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/utils/configure.js; echo ---; cat $U/components/theme/useLang.js; echo ---; grep -rln "subscribeConfigure\|LangContext" $U --include=*.js | head -20; echo ---; grep -n -i "i18n\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; sed -n 80,110p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; echo ---; cat $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -80; echo ---; cat $U/i18n/i18n.js | head -40; ls $U/i18n | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm -name "*.d.ts" | head;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/controls/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; find $U -name "SegmentedRadioGroup*.d.ts" | head -3; echo ---; cat $U/components/controls/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---; ls $U/i18n/ | grep -v map; grep -n "export" $U/i18n/addComponentKeysets.js | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "Props\|size\|view" $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $U/components/Text 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; grep -rn "addComponentKeysets(" $U --include=*.js | grep -v "export function" | sed 's/.*esm\///' | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; for f in Select/Select.d.ts Pagination/Pagination.d.ts controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/TextInput.d.ts Button/Button.d.ts; do [ -f $U/$f ] && { echo "== $f"; grep -n "^export\|: \|?:" $U/$f | head -45; }; done; ls $U | head -100 | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "" $U/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "options\|value\|onUpdate\|placeholder\|width\|size" $U/Select/Select.d.ts $U/Select/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; grep -rn "export interface SelectProps\|export type SelectProps" $U/Select | head -3; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/*.d.ts | head -0; grep -n "ControlGroupOption\|ControlGroupProps" -A8 $U/types.d.ts | head -40; echo; grep -n "export type ControlProps\|interface ControlProps" -A8 $U/types.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "" $U/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "export" $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "view\|size" $U/Card/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -n "peerDependencies" -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json; grep '"version"' node_modules/typescript/package.json; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "direction\|gap\|wrap\|alignItems\|justifyContent" $U/components/layout/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls $U/components/layout 2>/dev/null; find $U -name "Flex*.d.ts" | head -3; cat $U/../../../node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -0; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | rg -n "Flex" -C2 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace; timeout 180 npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/i18n@1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -n '"@gravity-ui' package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "color\|Color" $U/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "variant" $U/Text/text/*.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "caption-2\|body-2" $U/Text/text/*.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS = " -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -8; timeout 170 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cd /home/sandbox/workspace; timeout 170 npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git status --short
